summary: Resolved the second compiler failure set: the pending-intent recovery path now uses Runtime rather than the string-valued ClientEffectiveConfig trust field, normalizes cursor/page types, removes an erroneous double response projection, and handles immutable recovery-state fields without mutation. Added durable/atomic operator-escalation journal handling with resolved-key pruning and retry-on-persist-failure. Compiled and wired AutomationLivenessSupervisor into Client.fsproj and Program connection/invalidation/shutdown lifecycle; challenge wake/scheduler flags remain OFF.
